[Figure 2-8 profile] From the (IAF) the path descends along FB to 10 DME, then is level to 3 DME; "1200" is shown at 10 DME and at 6 DME (altitude figures in the profile are drawn with horizontal bars above and/or below them).
[Figure 2-8 profile] At 3 DME (X): "1200 PALS/ICLS" above the path; "1200 ASR/TAC" with "600" beneath it below the path; from 3 DME the path descends along FB to the ship (TAC).
[Figure 2-8 profile] Past the ship a dotted climbing turn is drawn to "4 DME/2 Min", marked "1200".
